label: Brace and extend
cue: Brace the back of your upper arm against the inner thigh, palm up.

label: Curl upward
cue: Bend the elbow while keeping your upper arm supported.

label: Finish the curl
cue: Curl toward the shoulder without lifting the upper arm away.

label: Squeeze
cue: Hold briefly with a neutral wrist and no torso swing.

label: Controlled lowering
cue: Lower along the same path, maintaining thigh support.

label: Return to stretch
cue: Reach a near-straight elbow under control before the next curl.
